task_title: Deflake test_ask_stores_nothing_when_a_gate_refuses_the_proposal: parametrized stub arm flips RED on ambient contention at a green tip
task_criteria: The parametrized test tests/test_auger.py::test_ask_stores_nothing_when_a_gate_refuses_the_proposal is deterministic: when the child cannot run live arms because the AUGER_BLOCKED_BY full-fleet-sync sentinel is present, the parent classifies that as a NAMED SKIP carrying the blocked-by line instead of failing its exact-shape assertion; the failing param from run 4572d101 (stub returned no answered-verdict) has its ambient cause identified or the defect fixed; a regression test hands the child a simulated sentinel and asserts a named skip not FAIL, red-proofed against the pre-fix tree; and bash tests/gate.sh exits 0 in three consecutive runs at the graded tip.
